title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Bulevardi i Ri, Tiranë (ID: 530181053-651)
description_sq:
Apartament 2+1+2 ne shitje tek Bulevardi i Ri per 212`000Euro!
Objekti ndodhet ne nje prej zonave qendrore te kryeqytetit sic eshte Bulevardi i Ri, prane te gjitha facilitetetve per nje jetese komode, qendres se Tiranes dhe te gjitha rrugeve kryesore te saj.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 106m2, te organizuar ne nje sallon ndenje + ambientin e gatimit/ngrenies disi te vecuar, dy dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, nje depo/lavanderi, korridori qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve dhe nje ballkoni te bollshem, i orientuar Jug.
Kompleksi eshte nje nder me te miret ne zone me nje arkitekture te vecante dhe cilesi te larte punimesh ku vlejne te theksohen:
- Termoizolim me sistem kapot dhe tulle terrakote,
- Vetrata alumini termik, dopioxham,
- Tualete incasso, shtrim me parket, dyert MDF, etj.
- Residenca ofron sheshe rekreative, dalje emergjence, sisteme menaxhimi për ndërtesat (BMS), sistem sigurie 24 orë, struktura RCC rezistente ndaj tërmeteve dhe shkallë me mbrojtje ndaj zjarrit.
Objekti eshte ne faze te avancuar punimesh me afat dorezimi vitin e ardhshem.
Per me shume informacion kontaktoni!
title_en: Apartment - For Sale - New Boulevard, Tirana (ID: 530181053-651)
description_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale at New Boulevard for 212,000 Euros! The facility is located in one of the central areas of the capital, such as the New Boulevard, near all the facilities for a comfortable life, the center of Tirana and all its main roads. The apartment has a total area of ​​106m2, organized in a living room + somewhat separate cooking/dining area, two bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a storage room/laundry, the corridor that distributes the premises and a spacious balcony, facing South. The complex is one of the best in the area with a special architecture and high quality of works where it is worth highlighting: - Thermal insulation with capot system and terracotta bricks, - Thermal aluminum windows, double glazing, - Incasso toilets, parquet flooring, MDF doors, etc. - The residence offers recreational plazas, emergency exits, building management systems (BMS), 24-hour security system, earthquake-resistant RCC structures and fire-proof staircases. The object is in an advanced stage of works with a deadline for delivery next year. For more information contact!
